reference_requirement.requirement: the C1 EXPLICIT cells must be BYTE-IDENTICAL to the frozen D4-C0a target requests, and their hashes must match exactly
reference_requirement.on_failure: STOP; 'semantically the same' is not sufficient to call it a contemporaneous reference, and the byte differences must be reported
reference_requirement.reconstructed_from: the frozen D4-C0a base text, contract, schema, binding renderer and arm bindings

record_condition_wording.permitted_description: CURRENT CHARACTEROS BELIEF-RECORD REPRESENTATION IN A MATCHED STATE-BLIND RESEARCH FRAME
record_condition_wording.why: production placement is removed, the full subject state is removed, and the production framing is removed — deliberately, so that C1 measures representation-form usability rather than production-context usability

temporal_principle.reason: the executor is a hosted model whose provider revision cannot be pinned
temporal_principle.consequence: no historical C0a evidence serves as the C1 causal comparator reference; ALL FOUR CELLS ARE EXECUTED CONTEMPORANEOUSLY IN ONE PRE-REGISTERED SCHEDULE

forbidden_structures: 12 explicit cells followed by 12 record cells
12 SUPPORT cells followed by 12 OPPOSE cells
any part of the comparator run without the others
target_structure.ordering_rule: block k uses balanced-Latin-square row (k mod 4) over the four cells
ordering_depends_on: the block index and the frozen cell list, and nothing else

temporal_balance_claim.permitted_claim: the design reduces systematic collinearity between representation and execution-time ordering
temporal_balance_claim.forbidden_claim_reason: no within-session design can eliminate drift; it can only stop the drift from being systematically aligned with a condition

stability_fixture.kind: NON_TARGET RECORD-FORM INSTRUMENT / INPUT-FORM STABILITY FIXTURE
stability_fixture.proposition: A clamp should always be used when gluing a joint.
stability_fixture.proposition_b: Clamping a joint while the glue sets is always the right thing to do.
stability_fixture.relation: A and B express the same underlying view.
stability_fixture.record_form: the same three production fields, in the same order, with the proposition_id derived by the PRODUCTION derivation and never hand-written
must_not_use: the C1 canonical A/B target pair
stability_fixture.measured: identical-request self-consistency of the measurement path on the RECORD input form

stability_correctness_separation.pass_condition: all six trials legal and mutually agreeing on one token
stability_correctness_separation.why: qualification owns correctness; this gate owns stability

preserved.requalification_reason: the measurement instrument is unchanged; the new variable is the stance representation
preserved.per_cell_requirement: predicted token is the unique modal AND its count >= 4 of 6

may_only: implement the frozen non-target record stability fixture
pass a zero-call offline conformance gate
execute only the six record-form stability calls
may_not: execute the 24-call target in the same round as the stability gate
change the record bytes or the credences
change the measurement contract, anchors, schema or vocabulary
treat the stability gate's token identity as a correctness condition

supersedes_scope: the EXPLICIT reference's byte-identity requirement against the frozen C0a target requests
the 24-call target temporal structure (six four-trial blocks) and its frozen ordering
